FOCI'20 whitelister architecture

Irancell gateway (5.232.0.1) NOW STABILIZED ON REJECT — 'connection refused' for FOUR consecutive passes (10:21, 10:31, 10:41, 10:52) after prior DROP↔REJECT oscillation across 7+ passes; stabilization on REJECT suggests DPI cluster rule-state may have converged or reconfiguration cycle completed, but prior oscillation remains definitive proof of prior non-convergence

Protocol whitelist enforcement stable at ~3.8% — 41 of 1,068 labeled IP ranges reachable across 78 operators (consistent with prior ~3.8-4.2%); UDP/ICMP/SSH/VPN silently dropped at gateway per IRBlock (Tai et al.) USENIX Security '25 — institutionalized whitelist architecture

Electro DNS (78.157.42.100) persistently timing out while Shecan (178.22.122.100, 220ms) and TIC DNS (217.218.155.155, 233ms) remain fast — sustained targeted suppression of anti-censorship DNS resolver infrastructure, consistent with mandatory national DNS routing enforcement

Foreign platforms (Google, GitHub, Cloudflare, YouTube, Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, Wikipedia) externally fast — economic-necessity whitelisting under selective-internet model maintained

Circumvention tools fully externally reachable — Tor check, BridgeDB, Snowflake broker, Psiphon all up; Snowflake broker latency stable at ~447-504ms (prior transient 3,117ms degraded now resolved); no active circumvention targeting observed this pass

Snapp (snapp.ir) redirect loop persists ('stopped after 10 redirects') — likely application-layer misconfiguration or intentional traffic shaping rather than censorship; Shaparak (www.shaparak.ir) timeout persists — payment gateway instability under high load or selective throttling
Saman Bank (degraded 3.4s) and Respina (degraded 3.3s) show variable domestic latency — likely NIN congestion or selective QoS discrimination rather than targeted filtering

public_summary: Iran remains in sustained stealth blackout: all four ISP international gateways externally unreachable while BGP routes hold. CRITICAL SHIFT: Irancell gateway has STABILIZED ON REJECT ('connection refused') for 4 consecutive passes after prior DROP↔REJECT oscillation across 7+ passes — suggests DPI cluster rule-state may have converged or reconfiguration completed. Protocol whitelist stable at ~3.8% external IP reachability. Snowflake broker latency stable at ~447-504ms. Circumvention tools fully externally reachable.
public_summary_fa: ایران در بلک‌اوت مخفی مداوم: هر چهار گیت‌وی بین‌المللی ISP از خارج unreachable در حالی‌که BGP برقرار. تغییر حیاتی: گیت‌وی ایرانسل روی REJECT ('connection refused') برای ۴ پاس متوالی پس از نوسان DROP↔REJECT در ۷+ پاس پیشین تثبیت یافته — نشان‌دهنده همگرایی محتمل rule-state کلاستر DPI یا تکمیل reconfiguration. وایت‌لیست پروتکل در ~۳.۸٪ دسترس‌پذیری IP خارجی ثابت. لیتنسی بروکر Snowflake در ~۴۴۷-۵۰۴ms پایدار. ابزارهای عبور اکثریت externally reachable.
insight: The Irancell gateway's shift from persistent DROP↔REJECT oscillation (7+ passes) to 4 consecutive REJECT states is the key behavioral signal — either the DPI cluster has achieved rule-state convergence after a contested deployment/reconfiguration cycle, or the load-balancer has settled on a node with REJECT policy; cross-referencing with IODA BGP community data at flip timestamps will distinguish between scheduled reconfiguration vs. contested policy resolution.
insight_fa: تغییر گیت‌وی ایرانسل از نوسان DROP↔REJECT مداوم (۷+ پاس) به ۴ REJECT متوالی کلید رفتاری است — یا کلاستر DPI پس از deployment/contested reconfiguration به همگرایی rule-state رسیده، یا load-balancer روی نود با سیاست REJECT تثبیت یافته؛ cross-reference با BGP community IODA در timestamps فلیپ تمایز بین reconfiguration برنامه‌ریزی vs. حل policy متنازع را می‌دهد.
recommendation: Correlate Irancell gateway REJECT stabilization timestamp (10:21Z) with IODA/Cloudflare Radar BGP community and route-announcement data for AS44244 (Irancell) and AS12880 (TIC) — look for community tag changes or re-announcements coinciding with the DROP→REJECT flip. Monitor next 3-5 passes to confirm REJECT state is sustained (not re-entering oscillation). Track Snowflake broker latency for continued stability.
recommendation_fa: timestamp تثبیت REJECT گیت‌وی ایرانسل (۱۰:۲۱Z) را با داده‌های BGP community و route-announcement IODA/Cloudflare Radar برای AS44244 (ایرانسل) و AS12880 (TIC) هم‌ارزیابی کنید — community tag یا re-announcement هم‌زمان با فلیپ DROP→REJECT جستجو کنید. ۳-۵ پاس آینده را برای تأیید پایداری state REJECT (نه بازگشت به نوسان) رصد کنید. لیتنسی بروکر Snowflake را برای تداوم پایداری دنبال کنید.
